what: The complete Mutable Dreams 2.1 as a native Vibe: six tracks of generative music, 271 Biomes, 16 performance pads with a gesture looper, a night garden – and a garden that listens: sing into IN 1 and it answers. CV, DAW song position, 50 pages, a stage and its own editor.
author: Kid Bunka
sounds: licensed: Mutable Instruments Elements sample data and Plaits sound banks/wavetables, MIT (Émilie Gillet; engine-2.1/app/third_party/); own: original synthesized kit samples, Satin wavetables and Biome banks (engine-2.1/tools)
